summary: An official checks whether anyone has acted on a constituent’s case before describing its status.
realLife: Representative Frank Lucas’s Oklahoma office asks residents seeking agency help to identify an application, complaint or other written contact they have already made. Staff can inquire about a decision the agency still controls.
inGame: needs: a matching earlier referral in the scene facts for a past-tense reply. The jobs engine records referrals.
gates: The official can identify the constituent’s case.

turns.what: The office finds the referral but cannot confirm that the agency received it.
turns.pulledBy: The case file contains a sent date and no acknowledgment.
turns.writesBack: The next task is to check receipt with the agency.

turns.what: The envelope the visitor brings contains a blank application. The agency has no claim to look up yet.
turns.pulledBy: The visitor confirms they never sent the form and has no receipt or case number.
turns.writesBack: The caseworker gives the resident the filing address and records the visit as help with an application.
